1. Description

This pairing examines acidity levels in the ocean, as represented by pH values. It focuses on four key locations where measurements have been collected consistently over many years. The observed component is part of Figure 1 in EPA’s Ocean Acidity indicator.

This feature includes the following components:

  • Historical observations since 1983.
  • Modeled projections from 2015 to 2100 for four climate scenarios.
  • A modeled hindcast from 1950 to 2014.
